[.walkthrough]
.Select a component, its layout, and its neighbors
. In *Edit* mode, click a component to select it. Its badge names the [.walkthrough-look]#component type#, here a button, and has the tools for it.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/select/01-click.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/select/01-click.jpg"]
. To select the layout around it, right-click and choose *Select* › *Parent*. The badge now names the [.walkthrough-look]#HorizontalLayout# that holds both buttons.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/select/02-parent.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/select/02-parent.jpg"]
. The arrow keys move the selection without the menu. `↓` selects the first component inside a layout, then the next one, here Cancel. `↑` goes back, and `←` selects the parent.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/select/03-keys.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/select/03-keys.jpg"]
. To select several components, click the first and kbd:[Ctrl]-click the others (`⌘`-click on macOS). Each gets a badge, with the tools that work on all of them.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/select/04-several.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/select/04-several.jpg"]
